scenarios.description: Insert a new paragraph of text mid-document.
Bold, italic and recolor a run inside a body paragraph.
Toggle a paragraph into a bullet list and another into a numbered list.
Add a row and a column to a table and merge two cells, then insert a new table.
Insert a small inline PNG at the caret.
Add a review comment on a selected phrase.
Add a footnote at the end of a body sentence.
Suggest an insertion and a deletion, then accept one and reject the other.
Change margins and orientation on the caret's section only.
Open the running header, type into it, and close header/footer mode.
Paint all six table edges, restyle the inside vertical rule, suppress one cell's top edge, and add a diagonal.
Freeze layout, then set a column width, table width, table cell margins and a repeating header row.
Clear the themed table style, reapply it, and set conditional-format toggles the authored file did not have.
